messages.content:
You are the Physics Investigator of Creature Forge. A person drew a planar (side-view, 2-D) two-legged creature: a torso with a REAR leg and a FRONT leg, each with thigh, shank, foot and hip, knee, ankle motors. MuJoCo simulates it under gravity 9.81 m/s^2.

CHALLENGE. WALK: the creature must walk forward for 10 s under a phase-based gait controller with 15 parameters. Score = forward distance in metres travelled while upright with a valid gait (0 if it falls within 1 s). PASS means the walking criteria were met.
Outcome per seed: PASS, POOR (did it, but with a small margin) or FAIL (fell / cannot do it); ERROR means the run itself failed.

HOW YOU ARE JUDGED. Your proposals are untrusted. MuJoCo will independently re-run the original creature and each valid proposal on fresh random seeds, and ALSO a matched-random edit of the same size and a simple rule-based heuristic. A change is adopted only if it beats the original significantly; your confidence is never used. So diagnose carefully and honestly. If no change is likely to help, say so: give low confidence (<= 0.2) on your best small proposal instead of guessing.
ACCEPTANCE RULE (verdict_v1): on held-out seeds, paired with the unchanged creature, the median per-seed gain in valid walking distance must be at least 0.5 m, and the gains must be consistent across seeds (one-sided sign test, p < 0.05). A change smaller than this is recorded as not verified even if it helps a little, so size each edit to the effect you predict (within the edit rules below).

EVIDENCE. The user message lists every measurement as one `path=value` line; these paths are the ONLY citable ones. Seeds are ordered worst to best by score (seeds[0] is the worst). Derived: leg_length = thigh + shank; foot_to_leg = mean foot length / mean leg length; weight_n = mass_total * 9.81; torque_to_weight = torque_limit / (weight_n * mean leg length); heel_behind_ankle_* and toe_ahead_of_ankle_* = how far each sole reaches behind / in front of its ankle in the compiled model (both scale with foot_length). A second section, EDIT BOUNDS, gives each editable parameter's current value and range.

EDITABLE PARAMETERS (mode: experimental):
- torso_mass [morphology; targets both] torso mass parameter (kg); sets the torso box density
- thigh_length [morphology; targets both|rear|front] thigh length, hip to knee (m)
- shank_length [morphology; targets both|rear|front] shank length, knee to ankle (m)
- foot_length [morphology; targets both|rear|front] foot length (m); the foot extends mostly forward of the ankle
- leg_density [morphology; targets both] density of every leg segment incl. feet (kg/m^3)
- foot_friction [morphology; targets both] foot-floor Coulomb friction coefficient
- torque_limit [actuation; targets both] motor torque limit of every joint (N*m)
- walk.freq [control; targets both] gait frequency (Hz)
- walk.duty [control; targets both] stance duty fraction
- walk.hip_amp [control; targets both] hip swing amplitude (rad)
- walk.knee_amp [control; targets both] knee flexion amplitude (rad)
- walk.knee_shift [control; targets both] knee phase shift (rad)
- walk.stance_knee [control; targets both] stance-leg knee bias (rad)
- walk.hip_bias [control; targets both] hip bias (rad)
- walk.kp [control; targets both] joint position gain
- walk.kd [control; targets both] joint damping gain
- walk.balance_gain [control; targets both] ankle balance feedback gain
- walk.pitch_kp [control; targets both] stance torso-pitch feedback gain
- walk.pitch_ref [control; targets both] torso pitch reference (rad)
- walk.sync_gain [control; targets both] contact-informed phase sync gain
- walk.ramp_s [control; targets both] start-up amplitude ramp duration (s)
- walk.start_lean [control; targets both] extra forward pitch reference at start, decays over 1 s (rad)

EDIT RULES. Each edit = {param, op, value, target}. op 'scale': new = old * value. op 'set': new = value. At most 4 edits, no two on the same field. Morphology/actuation: new/old ratio in [0.5, 1.5]; control parameters (stand.*, walk.*): the change in u = (value - lo) / (hi - lo) must satisfy |delta u| <= 0.25 (lo, hi and u are in EDIT BOUNDS). The result must stay inside the bounds: out-of-range edits are REJECTED, never clipped. target 'rear'/'front' applies to leg lengths only; every other parameter uses 'both'. The pose cannot be edited. A proposal's category must equal the kinds of its edits: 'morphology' (morphology and torque_limit), 'control' (stand.* or walk.*) or 'combined'. retune_controller may be true: every arm then gets the same short walking-controller re-adaptation after the edits. 

REPLY: ONE JSON object, nothing else (no prose, no code fence):
{"diagnosis":{"summary":"<=400 chars","hypotheses":[{"id":"H1","mechanism":"what physically happens and why","evidence":["<path copied from the EVIDENCE lines>"],"competing":["an alternative explanation"]}]},"proposals":[{"id":"P1","hypothesis":"H1","category":"morphology|control|combined","edits":[{"param":"<editable id>","op":"scale|set","value":0.0,"target":"both"}],"retune_controller":false,"prediction":{"metric":"score","direction":"increase","expected_change":"..."},"tradeoffs":"...","confidence":0.0,"verification":"..."}]}
Rules: 1-3 hypotheses with ids exactly H1, H2, H3 (upper case); 1-3 proposals with ids P1, P2, P3. proposals[].hypothesis is the hypothesis ID (e.g. "H1"), never its text. Each hypothesis cites 1-6 paths copied EXACTLY from the EVIDENCE lines (the path only, left of '=', no value appended); prefer numeric measurements. confidence is a number in [0, 1]. Keep every text field short.

diagnosis.summary: Creature fails due to falling forward quickly despite some steps taken; high knee amplitude causes overextension and instability during swing, leading to torque saturation and loss of balance.

hypotheses.mechanism: Excessive knee flexion amplitude (0.8595 rad ~49 deg) causes the shank to swing too far forward during late swing, shifting center of mass anteriorly beyond base of support, triggering forward fall. This is exacerbated by high torque saturation (saturation_frac up to 0.45) and observed hopping/contact chatter.
competing: H2: Low foot length reduces ground clearance and stability

proposals.tradeoffs: Reduced knee flexion may decrease step length and propulsion; risk of insufficient toe clearance if too low.
proposals.verification: Median gain >0.5 m expected based on reducing overextension while maintaining gait rhythm.

selection.rule: Screening only selects. Best AI arm = highest MEDIAN screening score among AI arms (ties: higher mean, then arm order); best baseline = the same rule among random_baseline + heuristic arms. Arms with any ERROR seed are excluded and listed. Validation (held-out seeds, original + selected arms + the selected AI arm's own matched-random twin, so every AI verdict has a like-for-like control on the same seeds) decides via verdict_v1. Model confidence is never read.
